link.title: Managing Cloud Projects
link.description: Projects are how work is organised in the Bitbybit cloud - a container holding related scripts, the assets they use, and the settings they share. Getting the structure right early matters, because scripts inside a project can reach each other's assets and are published and shared together. These pages cover creating a project, understanding what belongs in one, adding cover images so your work is recognisable in a gallery, and publishing a project so other people can open, run and learn from it.
